*      -->P_FIELD_INT    Dynprofeld intern                             *
*      <--P_DYNP_FIELD   Dynprofeld extern                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_POSS_ENTRY_OUT
             USING    VALUE(P_FIELD_INT) TYPE DYNPRO_FIELD
             CHANGING P_DYNP_FIELD       TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD.

  IF  P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 Z FMB2CMU
  AND P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 Z FMB2CMI.
    P_DYNP_FIELD-POSS_ENTRY = ' '.  "temp. WHTaste bei Bedarf
  ELSEIF P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 O FMB2CMB.
    IF     P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 O FMB2CMU
       AND P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 O FMB2CMI.
      P_DYNP_FIELD-POSS_ENTRY = '0'.  "WHTaste abgeschaltet
    ELSEIF P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 O FMB2CMU
       AND P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 Z FMB2CMI.
      P_DYNP_FIELD-POSS_ENTRY = '1'.  "temp. WHTaste verlangt
    ELSEIF P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 Z FMB2CMU
       AND P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 O FMB2CMI.
      P_DYNP_FIELD-POSS_ENTRY = '2'.  "perm. WHTaste verlangt
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    P_DYNP_FIELD-POSS_ENTRY = ' '.  "temp. WHTaste bei Bedarf
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " R_POSS_ENTRY_OUT
